name: apple-notes
title: Apple Notes clone
description: Apple Notes: iCloud and On My Mac folders with All iCloud, Recently Deleted and tags; notes grouped Pinned · Today · Previous 7 Days… with snippets, or a gallery of thumbnails; a Markdown note editor with checklists and tables; pin, lock, share, move, delete, search, swipe actions (ListRow) and new notes that spring into place. One SplitView at every size: three tiled columns on desktop (the list steps aside for the gallery), an overlay sidebar on iPad, a stack with large titles and back buttons on iPhone. Composed from SplitView (sections, large titles, supplementaryVisible), ListRow, Icon, SearchField, MarkdownEditor (classNames), Segmented and DropdownMenu.
